column1: # The one declared exception to "every face calibration renders is embedded": CJK (ROADMAP O189,
# V3 of the font-version ruling). textfit.py prices CJK at one em by rule and no face in the advance
# table covers it, so calibration names this family explicitly in every stack and lets the pinned
# render image supply it. A face is identified by the pair (collection sha256, PostScript name),
# never by its family: fontconfig chose a different face of the same collection when the family
#   family      the family every stack names, after the embedded script faces.
#   psname      the PostScript name CDP reports for a glyph drawn from this face.
#   collection  the file's basename in the render image, as fc-list reports it.
#   sha256      that file's digest. The render image is pinned by digest, so this moves only
#               when that pin moves; calibrate.sh records fc-list and the judges compare.
# Two rows, because a stack at weight 600 or 700 selects the Bold collection and 400 the Regular.
